## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| ---- | ----------- | ---- | ------- | :------: |
| <a name="input_alarm_email"></a> [alarm\_email](#input\_alarm\_email) | Address for alarm and budget notifications. | `string` | n/a | yes |

| <a name="input_aws_region"></a> [aws\_region](#input\_aws\_region) | AWS region for every resource. | `string` | `"us-east-1"` | no |
| <a name="input_bedrock_model_ids"></a> [bedrock\_model\_ids](#input\_bedrock\_model\_ids) | Bedrock model ids the worker may invoke (CC\_BEDROCK\_MODEL\_FAST and \_REASONING). | `list(string)` | <pre>[<br/>  "anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5",<br/>  "anthropic.claude-opus-5-5"<br/>]</pre> | no |
| <a name="input_certificate_arn"></a> [certificate\_arn](#input\_certificate\_arn) | ACM certificate for the console's hostname. | `string` | n/a | yes |
| <a name="input_environment"></a> [environment](#input\_environment) | Environment name. | `string` | `"dev"` | no |
| <a name="input_image_tag"></a> [image\_tag](#input\_image\_tag) | Immutable image tag deployed to every service (a git SHA or release version). | `string` | n/a | yes |
| <a name="input_mcp_gateway_image"></a> [mcp\_gateway\_image](#input\_mcp\_gateway\_image) | mcp-gateway image pinned by tag or digest (null: this repository's build in ECR). | `string` | `null` | no |
